method: Single-agent source-grounded evaluation; no statistical multi-agent benchmark. IDs 1–7 retain prior prompts for audit. All 20 cases fixed before execution/scoring; no replacements.

evals.expected_output: Record checkout mismatch and drift scopes; successful-index receipt unknown unless independently available; no fresh assertion from zero drift.
